title: Fractions Subtraction - Level 4: Word Problems
description: Solve real-world problems involving fraction subtraction

questions.question: Sarah had 3/4 of a pizza. She ate 1/4 of it. How much pizza does she have left
A recipe calls for 2/3 cup of sugar. If you only have 1/2 cup, how much more sugar do you need
John ran 5 1/2 miles on Monday and 3 3/4 miles on Tuesday. How much farther did he run on Monday
A cake requires 2 1/4 cups of flour. You have 3 1/2 cups. How much flour will be left after baking
A water tank is 7/8 full. After using some water, it is 1/4 full. What fraction of the tank was used
